title-group.article-title: Bacillus fixture strain F2 produces a useful metabolite

abstract.p: Bacillus fixture strain F2 was isolated from soil. It produced compound Q during growth.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: E. coli indicator cells were inhibited by strain F2. Growth occurred at 30.5 degrees Celsius. The phenotype was stable after storage.
